# `aitbc mining status`

Get the current mining status for a wallet.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc mining status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet to use for X-Wallet-Address auth |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc mining status
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc mining status --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
